faire_description: <para><itemizedlist><listitem><para><emphasis>tax_class_other</emphasis>: The taxonomic assignment of each MOTU was meticulously checked by hand, taking into account molecular, taxonomic and ecological characteristics.</para><para>Additional information on parameters and cutoffs used for taxonomic assignment, that have not been shared in the given record.</para></listitem><listitem><para><emphasis>screen_other</emphasis>: Data were checked for errors: 10% of MOTUs were randomly selected and checked by two people: taxonomic assignment was repeated and the number of reads per sample was confirmed.
